title: DLSS 3.5 Ray Reconstruction Denoiser Bias in High-Frequency Detail
root_cause: Ray Reconstruction neural denoiser introduces bias toward learned scene priors. High-frequency geometric detail (foliage, wires, grates) gets over-smoothed when ray sample count is low. Bias-variance tradeoff favors smoothness over detail preservation.
resolution_type: Detail-preserving fallback to SVGF (Spatiotemporal Variance-Guided Filtering) for high-frequency regions. Hybrid approach: neural for low-freq, SVGF for high-freq.
